name: Elektron Tonverk
description: Elektron Tonverk sampler: every parameter of its manual's MIDI appendix, as the controllers and NRPNs it prints for each kind of track, on the audio, bus, FX send and mix track channels.

sources.title: Tonverk User Manual, OS 1.4.1
sources.notes: MIDI appendix read by tools/profiles/elektron/read-elektron-midi.mjs from Tonverk-User-Manual_ENG_OS1.4.1_260923.pdf (sha256 0bcb08a1ffdd4ee3d603c2ddf454e082c47b44451b07d905029f2deba5292045), https://www.elektron.se/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Tonverk-User-Manual_ENG_OS1.4.1_260923.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/elektron/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/elektron/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI appendix, with its printed name, sent on the CC it prints (a 14-bit pair where it prints an LSB), or its NRPN where it prints no CC. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The appendix prints no ranges: each parameter takes what its controller carries, 0 - 127 (0 - 16383 for a pair). What a value shows, and the values of a setting chosen from a list, are in the parameter's chapter of the manual.
The channel variable is a track's channel (track 1's by default): the parameters go to that track. Set it to the AUTO channel to edit whichever track is active.
The Subtracks machine's parameters are laid out for subtrack 1 (NRPN MSB 1); subtracks 2 - 8 are the same at MSB 2 - 8.

Rows the appendix prints wrongly, given by the layout: Audio tracks SRC 1 Data entry knob H (machine dependent) (name SRC 2 Data entry knob H (machine dependent), printed SRC 1 Data entry knob H (machine dependent)).
The busChannel variable is 13 here: the manual prints no default for it; set it to the instrument's BUS CHANNEL (SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS) setting.
The sendChannel variable is 14 here: the manual prints no default for it; set it to the instrument's SEND CHANNEL (SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS) setting.
The mixChannel variable is 16 here: the manual prints no default for it; set it to the instrument's MIX CHANNEL (SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS) setting.
An NRPN-only parameter is sent as its number (MSB on CC 99, LSB on CC 98) and a 7-bit value on data entry (CC 6), which the appendix does not spell out; not checked against the instrument.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers (or NRPNs, as its PARAM OUTPUT setting says) when its knobs are turned
